name: Westfield Garden State Plaza
summary: Westfield Garden State Plaza is a premier luxury shopping destination in Paramus, New Jersey, featuring over 300 stores including high-end retailers like Louis Vuitton, Gucci, and Neiman Marcus. The two-level regional mall offers exceptional dining, entertainment including AMC Theatres, and modern amenities, making it one of the top shopping centers in the New York metropolitan area.
demographics: Westfield Garden State Plaza attracts an affluent, diverse demographic from Bergen County and the greater New York metropolitan area, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-income households. The trade area draws heavily from families and professionals aged 25-54 with household incomes exceeding $100,000, reflecting the wealthy suburbs of northern New Jersey. Shoppers are fashion-conscious consumers seeking both luxury and contemporary brands, with a strong preference for experiential retail combining high-end shopping, upscale dining, and entertainment. The center serves as a regional destination for special occasion shopping, particularly for the Asian-American and diverse multicultural communities prominent in the area.
description: Westfield Garden State Plaza stands as one of the premier shopping destinations in the New York metropolitan area, located in Paramus, New Jersey. This iconic regional mall features an impressive collection of over 300 retailers spanning two levels, including a distinguished luxury wing that houses prestigious brands such as Gucci, Louis Vuitton, and Tiffany & Co. The center is anchored by renowned department stores including Macy's, Nordstrom, and Neiman Marcus, offering shoppers an unparalleled selection of fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands. Beyond retail, Garden State Plaza provides a complete entertainment and dining experience with an AMC Theatres, innovative attractions like Dopamine Land and Horae Play, and an exceptional collection of restaurants including Eddie V's Prime Seafood, Fogo de Chão, The Capital Grille, and Seasons 52. The mall continues to evolve with exciting additions like the newly opened HEYTEA and upcoming stores such as Sukoshi and HOKA, while maintaining its commitment to sustainability and modern amenities including electric vehicle charging stations, free Wi-Fi, and convenient NJ Transit bus access.
